name: Balamurugan T
tagline: Cybersecurity and IoT enthusiast with hands-on experience in advanced vulnerability assessments using Nessus and OpenVAS. Proven ability to identify critical vulnerabilities, prioritize risks, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement scalable security solutions. Passionate about IoT innovation, ensuring seamless integration of secure technologies aligned with evolving industry standards.

achievements.title: HackathonX Capture The Flag Winner
achievements.description: Our team of 3 secured second place and received ₹50,000 cash prize in the HackathonX Capture The Flag competition organised by the National Cyber Security Research Council (NCSRC).
achievements.imageCaption: Receiving the prize from Former Supreme Court Justice V. Ramasubramanian, J. Jareena Begam, Deputy Commissioner of Police, Cyber Crime Cell and Director of NCSRC Dr. E. Khalieraaj.

achievements.title: Cyber Security and Digital Forensic Club Student Coordinator
achievements.description: Served as the Student Coordinator for the Cyber Security and Digital Forensic Club for the academic year 2024-25, organizing events and promoting cybersecurity awareness among students.

description: Developed and programmed IoT devices, ensuring efficient functionality and reliability.
Integrated sensors for accurate data collection and analysis.
Worked with cloud-based IoT platforms to process and analyze collected data.
Collaborated effectively within a multidisciplinary team to complete project objectives.
Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail in troubleshooting and optimizing IoT systems.
Performed web application security testing on designated test environments using Burp Suite.
Conducted vulnerability assessment and advanced scanning using Nessus, exploring scan configurations and identifying potential security vulnerabilities.
Practised network reconnaissance, port scanning and connectivity analysis using Nmap and network diagnostic commands.
Performed web directory and file enumeration using wordlists to identify hidden application paths and resources.
Gained exposure to digital risk protection and threat intelligence workflows through CloudSEK, including security alert validation and client communication procedures.
Observed SOC monitoring workflows using IBM QRadar, understanding security alert generation, event monitoring and initial investigation procedures.

projects.title: GitHub Repository Security Analyzer
description: Developed a Python-based security analysis tool to identify vulnerabilities in public GitHub repositories using pip-audit, Semgrep, and custom heuristic-based detection.
Identified vulnerable dependencies, insecure coding patterns, weak cryptographic algorithms (MD5 and SHA-1), and hardcoded secrets.
Implemented duplicate finding removal, false-positive filtering, and weighted risk scoring to categorize vulnerabilities into High, Medium, and Low severity levels.
Developed a FastAPI backend with an interactive dashboard for displaying security findings, risk scores, and vulnerability statistics.
Integrated PDF security report generation using ReportLab to provide downloadable vulnerability assessment reports.

projects.title: Secure Electronic Health Record (EHR) Management System
description: Developed a Python-based EHR management application using PyQt5, implementing user authentication and a graphical dashboard for patient record management.
Implemented AES-256 encryption for patient records and SHA-256 hashing for data integrity verification, with a local blockchain-based mechanism for maintaining tamper-evident audit logs.

Integrated Suricata IDS to retrieve and display network security alerts within the application, and conducted a Hydra brute-force attack simulation against a Flask-based login server, with network traffic analysis using Wireshark.

projects.title: Comparative Analysis and Benchmarking of Web Application Vulnerability Assessment Tools
description: Conducted practical vulnerability assessments on a web application using four security tools: Acunetix, OWASP ZAP, W3AF, and Skipfish to identify and examine potential security vulnerabilities.

Performed reconnaissance, executed vulnerability scans, and analyzed the results to compare the tools based on vulnerability detection capabilities, scanning performance, usability, and reporting features.
Evaluated and compared the findings across all four tools, with Acunetix demonstrating the highest vulnerability detection in the tested environment.

projects.title: Mobile App Security Using Mobsf
description: Performed end-to-end mobile app security analysis leveraging APKTool, JADX, QARK, APKLab, and MobSF.
Identified and mitigated vulnerabilities in data storage, access control, and logging.
Delivered comprehensive reports, strengthening app resilience against real-world cyber threats.
